review.alternative: Inquiry-based learning is context-specific to biological human education and may not transfer to digital optimization agents.

claims.statement: Inquiry-based learning frameworks may provide an architectural template for non-factoid research generation.

support.explanation: Suggests that structured inquiry processes, particularly multidisciplinary ones, are a recognized model for research training, distinct from simple fact-finding.

actions.limitations: Existing research is largely confined to factoid-based systems; the pedagogical shift toward inquiry-based learning is a theoretical parallel, not an implemented algorithmic framework.
actions.next_questions: Can the multidisciplinary structure of inquiry-based learning be mapped to constraint-satisfaction problems for autonomous agents?
actions.reason: Integrating newly collected evidence on inquiry-based learning into the existing framework for autonomous question generation.
actions.summary: This revision synthesizes findings on existing factoid-based research question models with emerging insights from inquiry-based learning structures to broaden the scope of autonomous research formulation.
actions.title: Operational Frameworks for Autonomous Research

proposal.summary: Updating autonomous research formulation framework to integrate inquiry-based learning principles alongside established factoid question generation models.
